about_short_description.short_description: SwiftSku is a management and analytics software for convenience stores.

product.name: SwiftSku Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application for convenience store owners to monitor sales, manage pricebooks, and receive real-time notifications of POS activities remotely.

product.name: Scan Data Reporting Service
product.description: A service that collects and submits POS scan data to tobacco companies to qualify stores for rebates and promotional programs.

product.name: Convenience Store Loyalty Program Management
product.description: A program management service that helps convenience stores implement and manage customer loyalty programs to increase repeat business and sales.

product.name: SwiftSku IQ Module
product.description: A hardware solution that ensures continuous back-office data collection and scan data reporting without requiring a computer to be online 24/7.
